public.title: Climbing Stairs
public.description: Return the number of ordered ways to climb n steps using moves of one or two steps. n is an integer from 0 to 45. For n = 0 there is one way: taking no steps.
hints: Consider whether the final move was one or two steps.
Keep only the previous two counts.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: For n greater than one, sum ways ending with a one-step and two-step move. Both base counts are one, including the empty climb. O(n) time and O(1) space.
